content.short: VaultVision is a Hyperliquid vault scanner comparing TVL, risk, drawdown and returns.
content.description: VaultVision compares Hyperliquid vaults on the measures that decide whether a strategy is actually good, including drawdown and risk rather than headline return alone. A vault showing strong returns and a deep historical drawdown is a different proposition from one showing the same return smoothly, and most interfaces show only the first number.
content.meta: Compares Hyperliquid vaults on drawdown and risk, not just headline return.
